description: Erection of a part single part double storey side and rear extension with conversion of existing garage into habitable room and replacement of front garage door with window.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Drawings 01, 02 (Existing Elevations), 03, 04, 06 and 07 and Fire Safety Statement, received 07/02/2022 and Drawing 02 (Proposed Elevations) (Rev.A), received 22/03/2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved unless these are obscure-glazed and non-opening below 1.7 metres.
